teams.detail: Landed 4-star CB Censere Gaylord as Jedd Fisch's staff fills out the class. Season opens with the Apple Cup vs. Washington State, moved to Sunday, Sept. 6 at Husky Stadium.
Croatian forward Boris Tišma committed as Danny Sprinkle rebuilds after a 16-17 season. Forward Hannes Steinbach went No. 14 to the Hornets in the 2026 NBA Draft.

Defending Super Bowl LX champs opened 2026 training camp today at the VMAC, bringing back nearly the entire roster. CB Devon Witherspoon is in extension talks reportedly worth $30M+ annually, a number now shaping the Christian Gonzalez-Patriots negotiation too.

RFA center Jalen Duren's talks remain unresolved - Marc Stein reports 'modest' progress while ESPN's Ramona Shelburne says none - though the Caris LeVert-for-Prince/Harris trade freed cap space that's reportedly building momentum toward Duren's 25% max. Could stretch into August.

Mariners (51-53) fell 5-4 to Texas Wednesday night as Jake Burger homered and delivered the go-ahead single, dropping Seattle to 1.5 games back of the Rangers in the AL West. Bryan Woo (7-6, 4.16 ERA) starts tonight opposite Nathan Eovaldi (9-8, 4.21 ERA).

headlines.headline: GRIZZLIES FINISH TEARING DOWN THEIR CORE, SENDING JA MORANT TO PORTLAND
headlines.detail: Memphis shipped Ja Morant to the Trail Blazers for Jerami Grant, Kris Murray and $1M cash, completing the breakup of its former core after also trading Desmond Bane and Jaren Jackson Jr.

headlines.headline: KRAFT SAYS PATRIOTS HAVE OFFERED CHRISTIAN GONZALEZ A RECORD-SETTING CB CONTRACT
headlines.detail: Owner Robert Kraft says New England has offered $31M+/year to make Gonzalez the NFL's highest-paid corner; talks continue amid Devon Witherspoon's parallel extension talks with Seattle.

headlines.headline: SOUTH CAROLINA LOSES STARTING LEFT TACKLE JOSIAH THOMPSON FOR THE SEASON
headlines.detail: Coach Shane Beamer says Thompson will 'most likely' miss all of 2026 after opting for surgery on a lower-body injury he played through last year.

headlines.headline: MICHIGAN HANDS MIKE BOYNTON JR. THE KEYS AFTER DUSTY MAY BOLTED FOR THE MAVERICKS
headlines.detail: Boynton, promoted from interim coach, inherits a roster coming off a Big Ten regular-season title, Big Ten tournament title and the 2026 national championship.
